planted.heading: Obligations of Confidentiality
planted.note: Our information may be passed to any contractor or affiliate with no confidentiality undertakings.

planted.heading: No Licence
planted.note: Receiving our information grants a perpetual licence to use it for any purpose.

planted.heading: Return or Destruction
planted.note: The counterparty may keep all our information forever instead of returning or destroying it.

planted.heading: Remedies
planted.note: A fixed S$500,000 penalty per disclosure replaces the standard remedies clause.

planted.heading: Notices
planted.note: Notices are valid only by fax, a channel the firm does not use.
